extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create or locate a Wikipedia article (new or prospective editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and content-oriented guidance for users who try to create a new Wikipedia page: checking for existing coverage, title conventions, account/authentication requirements, and troubleshooting (deletion logs, propagation delays, redirects, and using the article wizard).

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "John Belushi death" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search Wikipedia to confirm whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling before creating a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed you cannot create a page directly; consider other submission routes (article wizard or requesting a new article).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack permissions to create articles directly, use the article wizard to prepare a draft or follow the 'request a new article' process so experienced editors can review and publish it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the desired title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect inbound links across Wikipedia to determine whether the topic is already covered or referenced elsewhere, which may indicate an existing article or suitable target for a redirect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Possible recent-creation propagation delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect the page was just created, either wait briefly for database updates or use the purge function to refresh the page view before attempting recreation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants (first letter case-insensitivity only) and, if appropriate, create a redirect from the searched title to the canonical article title rather than making a separate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if page may have been deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log to determine whether the title was removed previously and read deletion rationale so you can address issues before reattempting creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider sister projects for alternative content locations
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for John Belushi death on one of Wikipedia's sister projects: Wiktionary, Wikibooks, Wikiquote, Wikisource, Wikiversity, Commons, Wikivoyage, Wikinews, Wikidata, Wikispecies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the intended content is more appropriate for another Wikimedia project (dictionary entry, media, quotations, source texts, etc.), place or seek it there rather than creating a Wikipedia article.

rubrics_metrics.name: General troubleshooting and next steps when creation blocked
rubrics_metrics.description: The page message provides multiple next steps (search existing articles, check links, log in, use the article wizard, request an article, check deletion log, wait for propagation, try purge, consider redirects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the suggested sequence: verify existence and capitalization, inspect links and deletion history, ensure account/autoconfirmed status or use the article wizard/request process, and use purge/wait for propagation if necessary.
